title: Regime-Dependent Validity in Energy-Flow Cosmology: Evidence from SPARC Galaxy Rotation Curves and the EFC-R Framework
abstract: A pilot-scale analysis applying Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC) to 20 SPARC galaxies spanning diverse morphological types, revealing regime-dependent validity where EFC achieves 100% success for LSB and diffuse dwarf galaxies but systematically underperforms for structurally complex systems. Introduces the EFC-R (Regime) framework with the decomposition E_total = E_flow + E_latent to delineate EFC's domain of validity.
